preconditions.description: The number of bracket types, and half the number of cards, is between 1 and 2 * 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Every integer 1,-1,2,-2,...,n,-n appears exactly once as a_i and exactly once as b_i
preconditions.description: Each integer appears exactly once on the front of some card and exactly once on the back of some (not necessarily the same) card.

preconditions.expression: -n <= a_i, b_i <= n and a_i != 0 and b_i != 0
preconditions.description: The numbers on the front and back of each card are between -n and n, inclusive, and are not zero.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'YES' if it's possible to reorder the cards, or 'NO' if it's impossible.

postconditions.expression: output == 'YES' ==> (next 2n lines contain a valid reordering of the cards such that both the front and back numbers are balanced)
postconditions.description: If 'YES' is output, the next 2n lines must contain a valid reordering of the cards where both the front and back numbers form balanced sequences.

invariants.expression: all(abs(x) == abs(y) for x, y in zip(front_numbers, back_numbers))
invariants.description: The absolute values of the front and back numbers of each card must be the same.

invariants.expression: all(is_balanced(front_numbers) and is_balanced(back_numbers) for is_balanced in [is_balanced_brackets])
invariants.description: Both the front and back numbers must form balanced bracket sequences.
